# pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_types (Data Source)

Kubernetes cluster types, with the worker packages and node counts each allows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_types" "all" {}

locals {
  dev = one([for t in data.pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_types.all.cluster_types : t if t.type == "dev"])
}

output "dev_worker_packages" {
  value = local.dev.worker_node_packages[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cluster_types` (Attributes List) Every cluster type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_types))

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_types`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Cluster type, such as dev or prod, accepted as a cluster's cluster_type.
- `worker_node_packages` (Attributes List) Packages worker nodes of this type can use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_types--worker_node_packages))
- `worker_nodes_count_max` (Number) Most worker nodes a cluster of this type can have. Null when unbounded.
- `worker_nodes_count_min` (Number) Fewest worker nodes a cluster of this type can have. Null when unbounded.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_types--worker_node_packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_types.worker_node_packages`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Package id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Short name of the package.
